note: Encounters (Stage H, H.1; D-151): the ships that turn up on the scope, and how each behaves. `wants` is what it is looking for (H.2 gives its boarding party that goal). `at` is the kinds of point it can turn up at and `weight` how often. `signature` is what it gives off on its own course and burning after us: what our scope has to read. `sensors`, `reach`, `keen`, `notice` and `sure` are how hard it looks: our signature times `sensors`, falling to nothing at `reach`, has to pass `notice` before it takes an interest and `sure` before it is certain; `keen` is how fast it makes its mind up. `speed` is its cruise and its chase, against our 1.0 at full engine power (a stern chase closes only by the difference). `standoff` is how far off it shadows us, and `shadow` how many seconds it looks before it comes in anyway. `patience` is the seconds it will search with nothing to go on, and `chase` the seconds of pursuit before it gives up. `decoys` is how hard each kind of decoy pulls it (0 not at all; a ship that wants cargo takes a crate and goes). `bluffs` is the chance each lie works, before the crew's negotiation. `alongside` is the seconds before its clamp goes on, what it says first, and (until boarding in H.2 and H.3) the old enemy ship that fights us when it docks.

items.name: Patrol cutter
items.blurb: Fast, well lit and by the book. It cannot be outrun, but its crew would rather read a clean manifest than open an airlock.

alongside.hail: Hauler, this is the cutter off your beam. Cut your drive and stand by your lock for inspection.

items.name: Raider skiff
items.blurb: A hot, noisy drive on a small hull, after anything in a crate. It is slower than a hauler at full burn, and it will stop for cargo left in its path.

alongside.hail: Open your hold and nobody has to come looking for it.

items.name: Bounty tender
items.blurb: Runs cold and listens hard, for one name on a warrant. It is patient and does not care what the manifest says.

alongside.hail: We hold a warrant for one of your crew. Send them across and you keep your ship.

items.name: Scrap hauler
items.blurb: Slow, half blind and loud. It wants hull plate and fittings, ours if we look dead enough, and it will follow anything bright.

alongside.hail: No answer on any channel. Logging her as abandoned and making fast.
